spec.name: Furniture Pumpkin Lantern
spec.description: A squat, stepped pumpkin lantern with a broad friendly carved grin, warm golden eyes and a short green stem. Nine connected cuboids form a grounded, single-block furniture piece; the front faces negative Z.

prompt: Create an original vanilla Minecraft furniture model: carved jack-o-lantern with broad friendly grin, warm eyes and green stem. Grounded attractive survival-server furniture. Entire model fits x=0..16, y=0..16, z=0..16; floor y=0, front negative Z. 16 units per Minecraft block. Keep a 0.25-unit margin at outer x/z edges.  Use 8-30 purposeful axis-aligned cuboids, no rotations, no bones, no animation. Detailed hand-painted pixel art, coherent palette, explicit non-overlapping cube-net UVs with correct texel density. Connected physical structure, no z fighting, no stand outside the furniture. No text labels, no surrounding scene. Generate the whole piece with its distinctive silhouette and materials.
